notes: This file records operational milestone state only.
M3 is the current active milestone for establishing the file-based registry and publication model of Atlas DataFlow.
M2 is marked as completed because the minimal public technical bootstrap cycle has been completed.
M1 and M2 are locked as completed milestones and must not be reopened without an explicit reopen record.
M3 should be validated against docs/milestones.md before workflow continuation.
Formal issues are resolved from the support workspace using formal_issue_location patterns; GitHub is only a publication target or human reference.
docs/milestones.md remains the planning document and must not be treated as the operational cursor.
docs/architecture.md defines the implementation documentation strategy; this file only records milestone state.
Issues, handoffs, workflows, and scripts may use this state as input for validation, but must not infer authorization to implement from this file alone.
This file should remain in the atlas-dataflow repository at docs/project-status/milestone-state.json.
The current milestone points to M3 because the next implementation focus is the file-based registry and publication model.

documentation_boundary.implementation_documentation: Defined by docs/architecture.md and reflected by docs/milestones.md when applicable; not decided by this state file.
